macro.text: October PPI +0.3% (0.4% expected), 6.5% a year, highest in nearly four years; December hike stays fully priced.
US Treasuries set for their worst week since 'liberation day'; 10-year near 5.15%.
Global oil markets swing to surplus as Gulf shipments rebound; WTI 89.08.
Fed survey: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system.
FAA issues nationwide ground stop citing communication issues at multiple air-traffic control facilities.

bigNames.text: Longest weekly losing streak since 2012, ~$1.7T of value gone; third affair allegation reported; Lutnick under scrutiny. Earnings Nov 17.
FAA nationwide ground stop at about 4:10 PM over air-traffic communication issues; airlines react Monday.
Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for the ~24-hour Outlook and Teams outage; easing, recovery timeline uncertain. Cerebras announced a Microsoft cloud deal.
Reported 600-megawatt computing power deal with Fermi (market chatter, unconfirmed).

read: Chip unwind held: SPY's 9:30 print (760.12) was the high, the low came at 11:35 (745.20), then a grind back to 754.25 (−0.38%); QQQ −1.20%. AMD, AVGO, CSCO took the puts side all day; NVDA fell to 158.39, then closed on 162.71 (162.85); CRWV and CBRS broke down, then reversed up. Money left SMH (−3.0%) for XLP, XLC, XLE. FAA ground stop after close. No red events Monday; NVDA reports Tue.
